title: IB4: Frappe adapter
design_classification: No new user-visible screen, dialog, component or copy (D6); no HOF-IB4 handoff required

acceptance.evidence: full local regression 20/20 PASS (1b1e5a1); exact-head CI 3a3f1d1 run 38973929929 20/20 green, PAEP / gate PASS (1b1e5a1 run 38972620462 likewise); independent QA final state HIGH 0 / MEDIUM 0; M1 CLOSED - REMEDIATED (atomic pmra.api.v1.apply_transition, no fallback); ADR-011 amended within the M1 boundary and ACCEPTED; public PAEP contracts unchanged

claude_md_disposition: PROTECTED GOVERNED ARTIFACT: narrow amendment permitting IB4-FRAPPE-ADAPTER only (policyChange)

backend_adoption_obligations_open.rule: The real ProSEIT backend must implement and validate pmra.api.v1.apply_transition with the concurrency, authorization, workflow-validation, conflict and idempotency semantics proven by IB4 (ADR-011 §2.8, §4; design §4.1). Until satisfied for a target backend: workflow writes MUST remain disabled for product pilot and production; the adapter MUST fail closed when the method is unavailable; there MUST be no fallback to the unsafe two-step sequence or to stock apply_workflow.
backend_adoption_obligations_open.blocks: enabling workflow writes against a real product backend until that backend is qualified
backend_adoption_obligations_open.does_not_block: IB4 platform acceptance (the adapter contract is proven against the approved deterministic reference backend model)
